# Example pack contract 0.1

This directory is a fixture, not a shipped pack. It exists so CI, the QA
smoke, the benchmark generator, and the CLI/TUI tests can install a real
external pack without depending on an operator-specific workflow.

The machine-readable source of the pack's claims is
[`manifest.toml`](manifest.toml) (spec `spec/pack-manifest.md`): verbs,
balance metrics, finding codes, `[checks]` keys, rule parameters and message
templates all live there.

## Verbs

### `grant`

```
DATE grant PERSON-ID package PKG-ID N sessions
```

Adds `N` units for a person. Malformed lines are
`E_EXAMPLE_GRANT_MALFORMED`; bad package ids are `E_EXAMPLE_INVALID_ID` or
`E_EXAMPLE_WRONG_ID_TYPE`.

### `use`

```
DATE use PERSON-ID DURATION [full|pps|comp] [note:NOTE-ID] [src:PROVENANCE]
```

Consumes one unit unless the entry is tagged `pps` or `comp`. A missing
duration is `E_EXAMPLE_MISSING_DURATION`; more than one tag is
`E_EXAMPLE_TAGS`; no tag is `W_EXAMPLE_UNTAGGED`. Entries dated on or before
`as_of` need a covering note or emit `E_EXAMPLE_WITHOUT_NOTES`.

### `session`

A generic event verb with no rules. It exists so the CLI's `log session`
write path can be exercised against this fixture.

## Metrics and context

`units_remaining` is grants minus consuming entries; `minutes_total` is the
duration sum in hours. The pack opts into the core `ledger-sessions` view
with `[context] view = "ledger-sessions"`.

## Findings

Every code and `[checks]` key is documented in [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md). The
pack uses only fake data.
